title: Apple Announces Oct. 28 Event for Touch-Screen MacBook Pro
summary: Apple Inc. on Monday confirmed that it’s holding a product launch event on Oct. 28, where the company is planning to debut its first touch-screen MacBook.

title: Proofpoint's $6.3 Billion Cybersecurity Bet
summary: Thoma Bravo-backed Proofpoint agreed to buy Varonis in a deal valued at about $6.3 billion. The companies say combining email, collaboration, and data security could create a broader cybersecurity platform, just as AI agents and rising customer demand accelerate industry consolidation. Thoma Bravo Managing Partner Seth Boro joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about the deal. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Biotech Firm Colossal Set to Return Extinct Bird’s Egg to New Zealand
summary: The biotech firm trying to bring extinct species back to life, Colossal Biosciences Inc., has acquired a rare egg of a flightless bird called the moa and will return it to its native New Zealand.

title: S&P 500 Index, Semiconductor Stocks Rally as CoreWeave Gains
summary: Chips companies and troubled artificial-intelligence bellwether CoreWeave Inc. rallied in Monday trading, helping stocks rebound after the worst week for the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index since the tariff turmoil of April 2025.

title: Tech Earnings Ahead: SpaceX, Meta to Test AI Monetization
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence’s Mandeep Singh says this week’s tech earnings could shift a recent market rebound, amid crosscurrents including concerns about financing and volatility in cloud businesses. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: DOJ Calls for Detaining OpenAI Engineer, Citing Saudi Ties
summary: The Justice Department urged a federal judge to deny a request for bail by the OpenAI software engineer charged with using a hidden recording device in one of the company’s offices.

title: US Moves to Bar China’s DeepSeek From Federal Agencies’ Systems
summary: The Trump administration barred civilian US government agencies from using products or services from Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek, citing a potential threat to national security from the company’s operations in China.

title: Nasdaq 100 Climbs on AI Trade Revival After Rout
summary:
A rally in giant chipmakers buoyed the stock market as dip buyers emerged on bets the artificial-intelligence investment boom will continue to support solid earnings.
Nimrit Kang, CIO at North Star Asset Management, discusses a growth scare amid an earnings-driven rally. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Vinted Awash With Suspected Looted Goods After French Riots
summary: Vinted, a secondhand online marketplace that counts France as its largest market, has seen an influx of listings suspected to contain looted items after riots broke out across the country.

title: Coreweave Gets Stock Upgrade; Cleveland-Cliffs Jumps on Earnings | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- CoreWeave (CRWV) share are higher in premarket trading as Goldman Sachs upgrades the cloud-computing provider to buy from neutral, a move that comes in the wake of heavy volatility related to concerns over the company’s debt.
- Cleveland-Cliffs (CLIF) shares jumped after it reported third-quarter profit that topped analysts’ estimates as steel prices rose and Trump administration tariffs eroded US imports.
- Intel (INTC) is gaining in the premarket as JPMorgan upgrades to neutral from underweight, noting that the chipmaker’s turnaround might take years, but the management’s execution has been solid. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic May Put Some Shares in 'Public Good' Fund
summary: Anthropic PBC says it plans on depositing 5% of its shares in a new fund for "the public good." The money could be used to offset AI's impact on the job market. The artificial intelligence startup is preparing for what could be one of the biggest IPOs ever. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: JPMorgan Deploys $230 Billion to Begin Security Push
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. deployed $230 billion of capital, providing equity and debt financing across a handful of areas, including energy independence and defense and aerospace, in the first year of its decade-long effort to plow $1.5 trillion into industries that bolster US economic security. Herman Chan of Bloomberg Intelligence has more on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nscale Says Microsoft Has Withdrawn From UK Data Center Deal
summary: Microsoft Corp. has pulled out of a UK data center deal with Nscale, the British neocloud firm said, marking a setback for the startup’s initial public offering hopes.

title: Academy’s Tchir Fears AI Debt May Trigger Sharp Selloff
summary: Peter Tchir, head of macro strategy at Academy Securities, says he is “nervous” about a potential selloff of artificial intelligence-related debt as he sees “faux liquidity” in markets. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chip Startup Tenstorrent Raises Funds at $6.2 Billion Value
summary: AI chip startup Tenstorrent Inc., after attracting takeover interest earlier this year, has raised $1.5 billion from investors in a funding round that boosts its valuation to $6.2 billion.

title: Amazon and AEP Explore 960-Megawatt Nuclear Project in Indiana
summary: American Electric Power Co. is working with Amazon.com Inc. to evaluate plans for a 960-megawatt nuclear plant in Indiana using a new reactor design, a project that would rely on unproven technology while potentially advancing efforts to promote next-generation fission.

title: Market Stress Mostly Driven by Technicals, Says HSBC’s Kettner
summary: “It is an incredibly technically-driven market,” says Max Kettner, chief multi-asset strategist at HSBC. He doesn’t see any kind of fundamental catalyst, outside of earnings, calming some nerves around concerns about artificial intelligence. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Marc Andreessen’s Techno-Optimism Leaves Some Supporters Shaking Their Heads
summary: His views on what’s holding back tech seem overblown even to many supporters

title: Musk Pledges SpaceX Shares to ‘Every Kid in America’
summary: Elon Musk says he will gift a share of SpaceX to each American child, in a post on X, the social media platform he owns. The move comes just hours after artificial intelligence competitor Anthropic PBC said it would set aside a portion of its shares for the public benefit. Matt Bloxham of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
